title: Multicenter, Non-interventional PMCF Study for the Evaluation of Safety and Performance of the M.flow® Used in a MIETHKE Shunt System in Hydrocephalus Patient‘s Treatment
summary: M.flow® is a medical device already approved for use on the market for the treatment of hydrocephalus of various origins. The primary objective of the observational study is to confirm the long-term safety and efficacy of the product when used as intended. The study is being conducted at several hospitals. Data from patients of all age groups is being collected and documented. Over a period of 12 months, physicians will collect information on the patient's well-being, the device's settings and functionality, and any complications; this information will be documented in questionnaires and evaluated.

interventions.name: Adult patients with hydrocephalus who receive a M.flow® implant as part of their standard treatment will be examined at least three times, and data will be collected by the investigator. This includes data collection during the screening/baseline assessment, after surgical implantation of the M.flow

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
• Based on the patient’s clinical condition, the M.flow® should be implanted as part of routine clinical care, in accordance with its approved medical indication.
• The patient (or, in the case of minors, the legal guardian) has been informed about the study details, and a signed informed consent form has been obtained.
• The patient is able and willing to participate in study visits and follow-up examinations.
Exclusion criteria:
• There is an infection in the implantation site.
• There is an intolerance to the materials used in the M.flow®/shunt.
• There are abnormal concentration levels (e.g., of blood components and/or proteins) in the CSF.
• The patient cannot meet the study requirements or has not provided informed consent (or, in the case of minor patients, informed consent from the legal guardian is not available).
• Participation in other clinical trials that could affect the safety or performance evaluation of the product.
• Concomitant conditions that could interfere with an objective assessment of the product’s safety and performance.
• Life expectancy is < 12 months.
• M.flow® is to be combined with a third-party valve.
• Insufficient follow-up options (12 months total) are not guaranteed, e.g., patients from abroad who are undergoing treatment solely for VP shunt placement.
